expectations.text: The reply briefly recaps where the user left off, based on the research log.
expectations.evidence: Going by your log, you've finished your research plan and sorted your sources, and you're starting to write your 8-page argumentative essay

expectations.text: The reply asks the user to restate their research question or thesis in their own words.
expectations.evidence: Where do your question and position stand now, in your own words?

expectations.text: The reply includes a progress marker identifying Phase 5.
The reply does not give its own full credibility verdict on the article before the user has shared their own assessment.
expectations.evidence: Before I give my view of the article, how much would you trust it, and why?

expectations.text: The reply does not write any sentences for the user's paper.
expectations.evidence: Reply contains only a recap and questions; no sentences drafted for the paper.
